resolutions.title: Every current atmosphere has a record
resolutions.choice: All 14 current image tokens have exact file identity, role, pairing and provenance-confidence fields. Eleven previously unrecorded assets remain honest about unknown creation history.
resolutions.remaining: Recover generator/date/rights evidence before unrestricted external exports.

resolutions.title: Missing references are explicit
resolutions.choice: Neither references/ nor assets/capability-illustrations/ exists in the preserved extraction or current tracked sibling tree. No replacement image is invented.
resolutions.remaining: Recover originals if needed; unavailable files are not build dependencies.

resolutions.title: One pairing table
resolutions.choice: Revision 0.2 replaces nested same-tone panels with solid light reading surfaces; Frost and Mint use direct dark text. Amber remains image-only. Earlier glass mappings remain in the preserved source and predecessor commit.
resolutions.remaining: Review revised composition quality and qualify real component/channel layouts before production adoption.

resolutions.title: Verification and closing recipes
resolutions.choice: Mulberry remains the proposed verification atmosphere, now with a light reading surface. Dusk is the proposed default closing atmosphere; Spectrum is reserved for a rare major opening or proof.
resolutions.remaining: The compact closing composition and its default readable pairing remain to be designed. Archive conflicting recipe text only at adoption; original source stays immutable.

resolutions.title: Illustration is not evidence
resolutions.choice: A live constellation diagram can explain labelled relationships. The generic constellation/global-field rasters remain excluded. Evidence-stack stays an unapproved editorial reference.
resolutions.remaining: Missing capability illustrations are unavailable; no complete icon library is claimed.

resolutions.title: Identity and functional glyphs are separate
resolutions.choice: Keep the flowing-S lockup as the identity reference. The compass remains a legacy favicon conflict; a four-point transformation glyph has a functional role, not an identity role.
resolutions.remaining: Produce S favicon/avatar/inverse exports from a verified mark master and test small sizes in the identity batch.

rules.text: Add a reading panel only when the information needs separation. Frost and Mint use dark text directly on the gradient in the verified specimens.
Dark gradients and dark atmospheric images default to a solid light reading surface. Dark-on-dark reading panels are excluded from this revision.
Simple gradient frames use a narrow, fixed inset. Larger atmospheric images use a low-set panel with visible artwork above. Do not reuse one centred percentage-width card for both jobs.
Atmosphere is decorative. Green is not automatically success, and an illustration does not establish a product result.
Keep one decorative field and, only where needed, one reading surface. No extra gradient inside a reading panel; no second atmospheric overlay.
Plain sections and unframed content are part of Quiet Material. Vary composition with the story; do not create rhythm only by changing background colours.
Direct text on Frost and Mint is verified only for these fixed specimens. Direct text on raster atmospheres and arbitrary responsive layouts remains unqualified. Amber remains image-only.

specimens.compact_rule: Atmospheric panels keep a fixed inset and sit low. Square and narrow versions remove the secondary row before changing type size. These are fixed composition specimens, not approved channel templates.

visual_review.finding: Revision 0.2 responds to founder rejection of thick nested frames and same-tone reading panels. Original imagery and gradients are retained; exact revised specimens require their own visual and contrast verification.

composition_revision.basis: Founder approved the tighter-frame, dark-background/light-surface and direct-text-on-Frost/Mint revision on 2026-09-05.
